description: This Java source file defines a custom Android UI component LogView that extends TextView to display log messages. It implements the LogNode interface to be part of a logging chain, formatting log data and appending it to the view, and forwarding logs to the next LogNode if present.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages, implementing the LogNode interface for chainable logging. It formats log data, appends it to the view, and forwards logs to the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data into a string, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, then appends it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
